source_passages.verified_source_summary: Each agent has a critic using its own observation, a shared observation encoder and an individual head.
The action-value critic combines encoded local observation with the collective action.
Critic and actor targets/updates follow a soft actor-critic formulation.
Baselines are selected for performance, reproducibility, discrete-action handling and similarity.

MARC.bounded_reading: MARC uses per-agent local-observation action-value critics, shared relational encoder, individual heads and SAC-style updates. This differs from our single centralized state-value critic and on-policy PPO/native return path; it neither prescribes the 640-parameter gate nor proves a capacity explanation or requires graph/SAC conversion.
MARC.changes_to_proposal: Keep the strongest attained ordinary same-information MLP as comparator. Describe intact-body-plus-gate as an explicit source-based performance hypothesis; do not claim literature support for recovering 768 gains.
